SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_projects,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'CREATED' THEN 1 END) AS active_projects,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETE' THEN 1 END) AS completed_projects
FROM projects;

WITH filtered_projects AS (
  SELECT 
    p.project_id, 
    p.project_name, 
    p.start_date, 
    p.end_date, 
    p.status, 
    p.description, 
    p.is_yt_project, 
    p.git_repository
  FROM projects p
  WHERE 
    CASE 
      WHEN '{{ $json.search }}' != '' THEN p.project_name ILIKE '%{{ $json.search }}%' 
      ELSE TRUE 
    END
    AND CASE 
      WHEN '{{ $json.status }}' != '' THEN p.status = '{{ $json.status }}' 
      ELSE TRUE 
    END
),
project_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    fp.*,
    -- Count of components used in this project
    COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pc.component_id), 0) as component_count,
    
    -- Total cost: sum of (quantity_used * latest unit_cost for each component)
    COALESCE(
      SUM(
        pc.quantity_used * COALESCE(
          (
            SELECT op.unit_cost 
            FROM order_parts op 
            WHERE op.component_id = pc.component_id 
            ORDER BY op.order_part_id DESC 
            LIMIT 1
          ), 
          0
        )
      ), 
      0
    ) as total_cost
  FROM filtered_projects fp
  LEFT JOIN project_components pc ON fp.project_id = pc.project_id
  GROUP BY 
    fp.project_id, 
    fp.project_name, 
    fp.start_date, 
    fp.end_date, 
    fp.status, 
    fp.description, 
    fp.is_yt_project, 
    fp.git_repository
),
paginated_projects AS (
  SELECT * FROM project_stats
  ORDER BY project_id DESC
  {{ $json.limit ? 'LIMIT ' + $json.limit : 'LIMIT 12' }}
  {{ $json.offset ? 'OFFSET ' + $json.offset : 'OFFSET 0' }}
)
SELECT 
  *,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM filtered_projects) AS total_records
FROM paginated_projects;

INSERT INTO projects (
  project_name, 
  start_date, 
  end_date, 
  status, 
  description, 
  is_yt_project, 
  git_repository
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.project_name }}',
  {{ $json.start_date ? "'" + $json.start_date + "'" : "NULL" }},
  {{ $json.end_date ? "'" + $json.end_date + "'" : "NULL" }},
  '{{ $json.status }}',
  '{{ $json.description }}',
  {{ $json.is_yt_project }},
  {{ $json.git_repository ? "'" + $json.git_repository + "'" : "NULL" }}
)
RETURNING *;
DELETE FROM projects WHERE project_id = {{ $json.project_id }} RETURNING *;

WITH project_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    p.*,
    COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT pc.component_id), 0) as component_count,
    COALESCE(
      SUM(
        pc.quantity_used * COALESCE(
          (
            SELECT op.unit_cost 
            FROM order_parts op 
            WHERE op.component_id = pc.component_id 
            ORDER BY op.order_part_id DESC 
            LIMIT 1
          ), 
          0
        )
      ), 
      0
    ) as total_cost
  FROM projects p
  LEFT JOIN project_components pc ON p.project_id = pc.project_id
  WHERE p.project_id = {{ $json.project_id }}
  GROUP BY 
    p.project_id,
    p.project_name,
    p.start_date,
    p.end_date,
    p.status,
    p.description,
    p.is_yt_project,
    p.git_repository
)
SELECT * FROM project_stats;
UPDATE video SET {{ $json.updateClause }} WHERE projects_id = {{ $json.project_id }} RETURNING *;

WITH purchased_cte AS (
    SELECT component_id, SUM(quantity_ordered) AS purchased
    FROM order_parts
    GROUP BY component_id
),
used_cte AS (
    SELECT component_id, SUM(quantity_used) AS used
    FROM (
        SELECT component_id, quantity_used FROM project_components
        UNION ALL
        SELECT component_id, quantity_used FROM general_usage
    ) AS combined_usage
    GROUP BY component_id
),
avg_price_cte AS (
    SELECT component_id, AVG(unit_cost) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM order_parts
    GROUP BY component_id
),
total_items_cte AS (
    SELECT COUNT(1) AS total_items
    FROM components
    WHERE name ILIKE '%{{ $json.params.name }}%'
)
SELECT 
     pc.quantity_used,
    c.name,
    c.component_id AS ID,
    c.description,
    c.date_added,
    c.image_content,
    c.image_type,
    b.box_code,
    c.category_id,
    b.box_label,
    ct.category_name,
    b.box_id,
    COALESCE(purchased_cte.purchased, 0) AS purchased,
    COALESCE(used_cte.used, 0) AS used,
    COALESCE(purchased_cte.purchased, 0) - COALESCE(used_cte.used, 0) AS stock,
    total_items_cte.total_items AS totalItems,
    COALESCE(avg_price_cte.avg_unit_price, 0) AS avg_unit_price,
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(purchased_cte.purchased, 0) - COALESCE(used_cte.used, 0) > 0 THEN 'In Stock' ELSE 'No Stock' END AS status
FROM project_components pc
JOIN  components c ON pc.component_id = c.component_id
LEFT JOIN purchased_cte ON purchased_cte.component_id = c.component_id
LEFT JOIN used_cte ON used_cte.component_id = c.component_id
LEFT JOIN avg_price_cte ON avg_price_cte.component_id = c.component_id
LEFT JOIN boxes b ON b.box_id = c.box_id
LEFT JOIN categories ct ON ct.category_id = c.category_id
CROSS JOIN total_items_cte
WHERE pc.project_id = {{ $json.project_id }};
